**PotentialWax 1.1.2**, the first public release.

A melodic sampler in the spirit of Serato Sample: pick or dig a song from your own library, and get 16 cue points, matched to your project's tempo and key. See the [README](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialwax#readme) for everything it does and its limitations.

**Download** `PotentialWax-1.1.2-mpc-armv7.zip` below. It's for Gen1 (32-bit) MPCs on MPC OS 3.x and has been tested on an MPC One. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.

Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome. [Open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialwax/issues/new/choose).
